definition: הֲמֻלָּה , הֲמוּלָּה noun feminine rain-storm (?), rushing or roaring sound (?): קוֺל הֲמוּלָּה גְדֹלָה Jer 11:16 sound of a great storm , of wind fanning flames in tree (in figurative of Yahweh's judgement on Judah); > AV RV Da tumult ; קוֺל הֲמֻלָּה כְּקוֺל מַחֲנֶה Ezek 1:24 of noise of wings of living creatures in Ezekiel's vision (strike out B Co compare Hi ).
